newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 110.5 in May.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 110.5 in May.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) monthly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 110.5 in May from a revised 109.0 in April, ECRI said.

Faster growth in real estate loans and indutrial materials prices, a rise in the percentage of purchasing managers reporting slower deliveries and a narrowing of the yield spread between 10-year notes and three-month Treasury bills pushed the gauge up, ECRI said.
"What is clear is that the (FIG) continues to be in a cyclical upturn, but that the underlying inflationary pressures are not rising very rapidly," ECRI said.
